review.notes: No code fences and no image embeds in the OCR. All nine physical PDF pages were compared line-by-line (normalized) against the OCR; pages 1, 5, 7 and 8 were rendered for visual verification. The results table on physical p.5 is an embedded image (xref 38) without a text layer; every value and label in its OCR HTML transcription was cross-checked against the rendered page and all numbers match (prices, indices, percentages, Code Arena/GPQA scores). The printed cover title (p.1) and the page-2 header line 'Gemini 3.7 Flash - Model Card' are both printed in the source, so the two OCR title lines are not a defect. The 'Methodology:' caption and the introductory-price footnote under the results table were transcribed correctly. The OCR does not repeat the table image as an embed; that is the existing source structure and was not changed.
